verses.text: A psalm by David, for remembrance. LORD, don’t rebuke me in your wrath or discipline me in your burning anger.
Your arrows have pierced me, and your hand weighs heavily on me.
My whole body is sick because of your anger. My bones have no peace because of my sin.
My wrongs have risen over my head. They’re a burden too heavy for me to carry.
My wounds fester and stink because of my foolishness.
I’m in pain and bent low. I spend the whole day mourning.
My sides burn with pain. My whole body is sick.
I’m weak and badly bruised. I groan because my heart is in anguish.
Lord, you know everything I long for. You hear all my groaning.
My heart pounds. My strength is gone, and the light has left my eyes.
My loved ones and friends keep away from my suffering. Even my family stands far off.
Those who want me dead lay traps for me. Those who want to hurt me make threats and plot lies all day long.
But I act as though I can’t hear, as though I can’t speak.
I’m like someone who hears nothing and has no reply to give.
I put my hope in you, LORD. You’ll answer me, Lord my God.
I said, “Don’t let them gloat over me or boast when I lose my footing.”
I’m about to fall, and my pain never leaves me.
I’ll confess what I’ve done wrong. I’m sorry for my sin.
My enemies are strong and many. So many people hate me for no reason.
They repay good with evil and oppose me because I pursue what is good.
Don’t leave me, LORD. My God, stay close to me.
Hurry to help me, Lord, my salvation.
